rationale: With only 5 minutes to close, the wide bid-ask spread of 34.4 bps combined with high intraday volatility (ATR ~$0.93 on 5m bars) makes any directional trade extremely risky — slippage alone could consume a significant portion of any realistic profit target. The price is sitting near the day's low (10th percentile of range) with choppy 1-minute candles showing no clean directional momentum, and forced market-close liquidation in 5 minutes eliminates the ability to manage the trade properly.
